subject: Pen test closure: validation artifacts + security playbook request
body:
Message 1 (2027-01-10 09:12 PST)
From: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@fintechco.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: secops-team@fintechco.com
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pen test follow-up: scope clarifications + closure artifacts needed

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for walking us through the findings on Friday. Our audit lead asked for a compact package to close the outstanding items for our SIG/SOC2 review. Specifically we need:

- The final penetration test report (with findings and remediation status).
- Screenshots or config exports showing the specific setting changes referenced in the report (e.g., session timeout, SAML assertion settings).
- Ticket links or change requests showing the fixes were implemented and validated (preferably with test steps).
- A brief compensating-controls narrative for the one finding you marked as "partially mitigated" (we need to include this in our SOC2 workpapers).

We also have one quick clarification: the scope for the external web app — did the test include the staging cluster behind the WAF, or only production? Please confirm.

Can you share the package by EOD Thursday (2027-01-13)? If not, let us know a realistic ETA — our auditor will schedule an evidence review next week.

Appreciate it,
Alice Gomez\Security Operations Lead\FinTechCo

---

Message 2 (2027-01-11 11:03 PST)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@fintechco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen test follow-up: scope clarifications + closure artifacts needed

Hi Alice — thanks for the list. Summary answers up front:

- Final pen test report: yes, attached (redwood_pen_test_report_20270108.pdf).
- Screenshots/configs and ticket history: we can provide sanitized config exports and screenshots plus the Jira ticket history for each remediation.
- Compensating controls narrative: we'll draft a short narrative for the partially mitigated finding and include owner attestations.
- Scope: the test included production and the production-facing staging environment behind the same WAF; internal-only dev clusters were out-of-scope.

Plan/ETA:
1) Today (1/11): share report + high-level remediation status.
2) By 1/13 EOD: deliver config screenshots, sanitized exports, and Jira ticket history for critical findings.
3) By 1/20: provide the compensating-controls document and internal validation playbook (runbook + test steps).

If you need the compensating-controls narrative earlier for the auditor, tell us and we can prioritize.

-Jasmine
Jasmine Liu\Head of Sales Engineering (Security Liaison)\Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_pen_test_report_20270108.pdf (PDF, 5.2 MB)

---

Message 3 (2027-01-13 15:42 PST)
From: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@fintechco.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: secops-team@fintechco.com
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen test follow-up: scope clarifications + closure artifacts needed

Thanks for the report. A couple of quick follow-ups after our internal review:

- For Finding 3 (SAML assertion: missing audience restriction) we need a config snapshot showing the SAML provider configuration change (the assertAudienceAllowlist flag). A sanitized XML or a screenshot of the admin console is fine.
- For Finding 5 (session fixation on web dashboard) please include the test case you ran after the fix — a small note that shows request/response headers demonstrating the new Set-Cookie behavior and HttpOnly/secure flags.
- For the partially mitigated Finding 7, the auditor wants a one-paragraph compensating controls description and the name of the control owner for audit notes.

We also need confirmation the fix for Finding 2 (outdated dependency in image builder) has been deployed to production and not just staged. If deployed, a CI job link or an artifact checksum is sufficient.

Can you send these artifacts by end of day Monday (2027-01-18)? That should give us time to include them in our SIG submission.

Best,
Alice

---

Message 4 (2027-01-18 09:07 PST)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@fintechco.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen test follow-up: scope clarifications + closure artifacts needed

Hi Alice — attaching the requested artifacts and a short validation playbook. Notes below:

- SAML assertion (Finding 3): attached sanitized admin console screenshot (web-prod-config-sanitized-20270118.png) showing the assertAudienceAllowlist set to the fintechco SP identifier. See ticket RED-4821 for change request and PR references.
- Session fixation (Finding 5): included a small capture (jira-4821-ticket-history.txt) with the test steps and a sample Set-Cookie header after the fix; marked HttpOnly and Secure attributes are present.
- Outdated dependency (Finding 2): deployed to production on 2027-01-12; CI artifact checksum and Docker image tag included in jira-4821 ticket.
- Partially mitigated Finding 7: attached compensating-controls-narrative.docx — summary below and control owner.

Compensating controls (summary snippet):
- Control owner: Laura Bennett, Director of Infrastructure Security (laura_bennett@redwood.ai)
- Compensating measures: added layered runtime checks in the request gateway, deployed WAF rule exceptions with monitoring, and configured anomaly alerts to trigger a lock-step incident review. The planned permanent remediation is tracked in RED-4890 and expected Q1 completion; compensating controls cover expected residual risk in the interim.

Attachments: web-prod-config-sanitized-20270118.png, jira-4821-ticket-history.txt, compensating-controls-narrative.docx

Please confirm you have what you need for your SIG pack; happy to jump on a 30-minute call if any artifact needs reformatting.

Thanks,
Rishi\Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

---

Message 5 (2027-01-20 15:03 PST)
From: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@fintechco.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen test follow-up: scope clarifications + closure artifacts needed

Rishi / Jasmine — confirmed receipt of the artifacts and ticket links. The auditor ran a quick QA and had two minor asks:

1) Could you include a short cover note for each artifact that states: what it is, who produced it, and a UTC timestamp for when it was exported? (This helps the reviewer verify currency.)
2) For the compensating-controls document, please add the control owner signature block (name + title + email) at the top of the doc.

Both are small edits — if you can push updated files by EOD Friday (2027-01-22) we'll be good for our SIG submission next week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

-Alice
Security Operations Lead\FinTechCo
